title: Clean: defensive precondition check added
diff: @@ -4,6 +4,9 @@ export function dispatch(event: UserEvent, sink: Sink): void {
+    throw new Error("dispatch requires a sink");

ground_truth.explanation: A defensive precondition check is added for a value the type system already narrows. Type-checked callers are unaffected, and an untyped caller that previously hit a TypeError on the next line now gets a clearer error at the same point — the failure stays loud either way.
